paper_title: Resonant detection of axion mediated forces with Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
suggested_experiment_name: ARIADNE (resonant NMR axion-mediated force search, projected)
coupling_convention: |g_s^N g_p^N| dimensionless product of scalar (nucleon) and pseudoscalar (nucleon) couplings, exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 2
notes: This is the original Arvanitaki-Geraci proposal (arXiv:1403.1290) that became the ARIADNE experiment. It presents sensitivity PROJECTIONS only, no measured limits. Primary result (Fig. 2) is the projected reach for the monopole-dipole coupling |g_s^N g_p^N| vs force range (0.01-10 cm, i.e. m_a ~ 2e-6 to 2e-3 eV); Fig. 3 shows secondary dipole-dipole projections ((g_p^N)^2/4pi and g_p^N g_p^e/4pi) not extracted here. No numerical table is provided; data_points are approximate readings of the ultimate projected-reach curve from the figure description and the stated axis ranges (couplings span 1e-39 to 1e-24 on the plot), so they should be treated as indicative only. Sensitivity is explicitly independent of cosmic axion abundance, so no DM density assumption applies.
